title: Chess, But Waldo Finds YOU
summary: Standard chess vs Stockfish where SCP-4885 ('Waldo', horror edition) hides invisibly on a random empty square. Any piece of either colour that moves onto Waldo's hidden square is captured (Waldo 'finds you'), the square becomes permanently blacked out, and Waldo re-hides on another random empty square. Narrator loses several games (passive rook shuffling, normal play), and the final game ends in stalemate despite a material lead - the SCP 'wins'.
rules: Standard chess otherwise; player White vs Stockfish Black (3600).
Waldo occupies one hidden random EMPTY square; it is invisible to both sides (the engine does not know where it is either).
When any piece (either colour) moves onto Waldo's square, that piece is removed (captured by Waldo).

The square where Waldo struck becomes a permanently blocked black square ('these squares are forever taken away from the board'); pieces cannot use it afterwards [inferred: black squares on frames, transcript 13:05].
Waldo then re-hides on a new random empty square [inferred from repeated captures at different squares].
If your king walks onto Waldo you lose ('if I walk into Waldo with my king, I lose').
Squares a piece has already safely visited since Waldo last moved are known safe (player strategy, not a rule).
win_condition: Checkmate Stockfish (narrator never managed it; stalemate in last game counts as draw).
